column3: Close to the Hebrew; “from the LORD” renders “with the LORD” (the sense is uncertain).
Close to the Hebrew; “will you not be accepted” renders the terse “(is there) not lifting up?”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV follows the Masoretic text, which does not give Cain's words (“Let us go out to the field” is from ancient versions).
Close to the Hebrew; “punishment” renders a word that also means “iniquity, guilt.”
